title: Mobile Banking and Deposits on Sky Blue
summary: Covers Sky Blue mobile check deposits (daily limit $25,000; endorse checks, capture clear images, submit in the app; track status in deposit history and keep the check until confirmation), account interest (APY 1.25% compounded daily), and out-of-network ATM fee rebates (rebated up to 15 per month).
